summary: One Secure Agility camera (counter 244) covering 11 zones at Liverpool St / College St / Wentworth Ave, June 2022 to 12 April 2025, plus one stray day (24 Sep 2025) that the auto-fix already sets missing. Whole-camera outages are mostly auto-fixed, but several partial-day all-zone outages were not and are set missing for every zone. The footpath zones 304 and especially 305 (and the road zone 301 on Mardi Gras and similar event days) have episodes of phantom or crowd detections with plateaus of hundreds to thousands of counts, which are set missing; 305 also has an unexplained level drop from March to mid-August 2024.
